rawUserRequest: When a process problem is found, fix the process before resuming the blocked Work Item; do not leave recurrence risks or overwrite archive evidence.

declaredIntent.summary: Implement fail-closed detection and recovery guidance for stale-branch archive-sequence and traceability-ID collisions.

riskAssessment.reason: Concurrent or delayed Work Items can allocate identical derived identifiers on divergent bases; recovery must detect the collision before history is rewritten or a PR is merged.

executionDecision.reason: User granted continuing authorization for plan Work Items and explicitly required process corrections before resuming blocked work.

preReviewWarnings: Preserve immutable predecessor archives; do not implement a silent renumbering that changes archived evidence without an explicit recovery lineage.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Archive-recovery preflight compares the branch evidence with the target base before a rebase and refuses colliding archive sequences or traceability IDs with successor-Work-Item guidance.
Archive transaction scans every active artifact it will move and refuses trailing whitespace before generating an immutable archive manifest.
PR validation rejects duplicate traceability identifiers and archive sequences with actionable, distinct diagnostics.
Regression tests cover stale archive allocation, duplicated traceability IDs, and a valid sequential recovery record.
The remediation plan and traceability evidence record this process correction and its RFE-104 dependency.
guidelines: Keep evidence validation deterministic and fail closed.
Do not mutate historic archive artifacts to make a recovery appear clean.
Keep user-visible reports distinct from machine-readable evidence.

intent.problem: RFE-104 and RFE-106 independently allocated archive sequence 666 and traceability ID PLAN-DIRECTIVE-049 from divergent bases. Rebasing RFE-104 after RFE-106 therefore conflicts in derived evidence and can tempt unsafe manual overwrites.
constraints: Preserve existing RFE-104 and RFE-106 archives byte-for-byte.
Do not weaken archive integrity, PR, traceability, or coverage gates.
Record an explicit successor/recovery lineage rather than silently changing prior evidence.
intent.rationale: The prevention belongs in the process so future parallel or delayed Work Items fail before producing colliding evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The read-only recovery preflight rejects the collision and directs delivery through a successor Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a target-base collision fixture to tests/test_ai_check_archive_recovery.py.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a target-base duplicate-ID fixture to tests/test_ai_check_archive_recovery.py.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a unique target-base recovery case to tests/test_ai_check_archive_recovery.py.
